changelog: Floating menu stays on its orbit — the 5 buttons keep their positions on the circle at every bubble spot, even in corners
Press-hold the bubble for a trash can — drop it there and the floating icon is completely removed; turn it back on from Settings
Floating shortcuts now work from outside the app too — Keyboard switch, Voice, Copy and Settings work from the home screen and other apps
Keyboard voice typing fixed — it keeps what you say without wiping, and Gemini refine retries when it is busy
